newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE plans $150 mln GDR issue - sources.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE plans $150 mln GDR issue - sources.

text.p: Lebanon's biggest company SOLIDERE will launch a $150 million offering of Global Depository Receipts (GDRs) in mid-October, market sources in Beirut said on Tuesday.

The issue is being lead managed by Merrill Lynch with a consortium which will underwrite it and sell it to investors, the sources said. The GDRs will be listed on the London Stock Exchange, they added.
A SOLIDERE official declined to comment to Reuters on the report, which followed rumours on the Beirut market and reports in the local press that a GDR issue is imminent.
